floorPlans.note: Fifteen own-page metric sheets precede eight original brochure spreads and sixteen building plates. Source editions, units and totals remain distinct. Several printed totals differ from components. The metric 3 BR E internal range descends from 99.95 to 99.19 m², and 4 BR C prints an invalid 31st-to-29th floor range. The 4 BR D sheet prints 168.13 m² against components of 149.50. Other material conflicts affect the four-bedroom duplexes. Confirm the selected unit, floor and contractual schedule.

review.imagery: Root reviewed all forty-five source PDF pages through indexes, all twenty-six whole PDF drawings, fifteen complete own-page metric sheets and every enlarged area panel, both factsheets, nine native resources and all own-page contacts. Seven original native concepts, three corroborated own-page concepts and one unique construction photograph are retained. Wrong-project townhouse imagery, stock lifestyle scenes and repeated crops are excluded. All duplex levels, original notices and floor keys remain intact. Different metric and imperial schedules are preserved with their conflicts.
review.floorPlans: All selected whole original sheets, complete numerical schedules, source notices and every drawn level visually reviewed by root. Measurement and source-edition conflicts remain explicit.
review.location: Whole original map and factsheets reviewed. Travel modes retain source scope. Unreliable phase markers are excluded. Missing coordinates use project-name directions.
review.provenance: Ordinary GET receipts preserve URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256. Native source resources, independent numeric arrays, whole-page bounds and delivered pixels must pass before browser verification. Protected project identity and researched content remain preserved.

unavailable: Construction photo capture date, individual home entrances, explanation of metric and imperial schedule differences, and selected contractual drawing revision remain unverified.
